comment:
The cascade breaks per side, not per section. StereoSum::process reads output 0's channel count and output 1's independently, so patching one of the upper outputs splits that side alone and leaves the other side of the stereo pair joined. Nothing on the panel shows this.

The module has no parameters at all, no lights and no context menu; process is 34 instructions of adds and two conditional selects.

The panel prints L and R over each input pair, a small circle over the first output pair and a small dot over the second, which is how the two halves are told apart.
